plugins.name: summary-only
plugins.description: Hides tool calls, diffs and the text between tool calls so the transcript keeps your prompt and the final answer; pins your last prompt above the input and opens the session's changes as an HTML diff report.

plugins.name: decisions
plugins.description: Decisions Claude leaves for you are asked one by one with the question dialog, or listed and answered item by item in a form (/decisions); Claude then carries on with your answers.
